summary: For fixed delta and the explicit joint regime lambda>=pi T/2+O((log T)^2), an elementary uniform minimum-modulus estimate and an explicit known zero-density theorem give exact mixture/xi multiplicity transfer inside shrinking zero clusters. The original expanding-window count error is bounded by an explicit boundary charge <=Q_delta(T)=O_delta(T^(1-delta/16)log T)=o(T). Retained paths have phase-change error <=2/(3T), while holes keep exact integer charge. No positive-A moving-curve distribution or new zeta estimate is established.

claims.statement: On the fixed zero-free collar, Re D=(1/2)log T+Re(zeta'/zeta)+O_delta(1). Condition (25) suffices for A>=kappa log T. On a connected balanced modulus graph with A>0, V'=-(A^2+B^2)/A.
hypotheses: Off P zeros; a local or pathwise logarithm is specified.
For the graph law, a connected C1 balanced graph exists and A>0 on it.

claims.parameter_scope: Fixed delta; T sufficiently large for (24); lambda arbitrary in the local graph identity.
claims.error_bound: Effective C_delta on the explicit non-arithmetic part. The graph derivative identity is exact.

claims.title: Uniform minimum-modulus bound outside actual zeta zeros
claims.statement: Under the distance and disk hypotheses, log|zeta(w)| is bounded below by (12). In C\E the specialized lower bound is -F(T).
hypotheses: Distance from every zeta zero is at least d in (0,1].
For the C\E specialization, the collar and exception conditions (3),(6) apply.

claims.error_bound: Exact lower loss [25+log(4/d)/log(15/14)]log(200T); F(T) after d=T^(-2).

claims.statement: The zero multiset (6) has M<=Q_delta(T). Its disk union has ordinate projection length <=4T^(-2)Q_delta(T); every relevant cluster has diameter <=4T^(-2)M_j and stays strictly in C.
hypotheses: Each distinct zero is assigned a general-position radius in (T^(-2),2T^(-2)); its multiplicity is retained.

claims.error_bound: M<=Q_delta(T)=O_delta(T^(1-delta/16) log T); projected length <=4T^(-2)Q_delta(T)=O_delta(T^(-1-delta/16) log T).

claims.title: Quantitative expanding-window mixture zero comparison
claims.statement: For lambda>=Lambda(T), each full relevant cluster contains exactly M_j actual mixture zeros and xi zeros, counted with multiplicity. All mixture zeros in the closed window lie in those clusters. N_H(Omega)<=Q_delta(T)=o(T), and |N_H(Omega)-N_xi(Omega)|<=B_Omega<=Q_delta(T), with all original boundary zeros paid for by cluster charge.
hypotheses: Use the actual zero-based exception set (6), with multiplicities; no zero simplicity assumption.

claims.parameter_scope: Every pair satisfying (3),(5); in particular lambda=Lambda(T)~pi T/2. The general lower relation only gives T=O(lambda).
claims.error_bound: Exact cluster equality. Original-window discrepancy <=B_Omega<=Q_delta(T). Matched zero pairs within a full cluster have distance <=4T^(-2)M_j.

claims.title: Pathwise phase transfer and exact hole charge
claims.statement: On retained paths actual mixture and xi phase changes differ by at most 2/(3T); closed windings agree exactly through the single-valued correction log(1+exp(-lambda)/P). Each full cluster has D-period 2pi i M_j; deleting one circuit per relevant cluster loses exactly 2pi sum M_j, bounded by 2pi Q_delta(T).
hypotheses: Paths lie in C\E and phases are continuously lifted.
For the stated total deleted-charge bound use one positively oriented full boundary per relevant component; repeated paths retain their winding multiplicities.
claims.domain: Retained paths and full cluster boundaries in the collar C, entirely in Re w>1/2.
claims.parameter_scope: Every pair satisfying (3),(5), with the same explicit lambda-T relation as S02-T.
claims.error_bound: Pathwise error <=2/(3T); closed-contour error zero. Charge is exactly 2pi sum M_j<=2pi Q_delta(T), independently of radii.

claims.title: Conditional lower crossing count with one-unit break penalty
claims.statement: If J pairwise disjoint connected balanced modulus graphs have A>=kappa log T and ordinate lengths ell_j, their interior actual odd-level intersections number at least kappa log T sum ell_j/(2pi)-J; these crossings are simple.
hypotheses: A finite specified family of pairwise disjoint connected C1 modulus graphs exists.
P is zero-free along each graph, lambda+log|P|=0, and A>=kappa log T>0.
Continuous phase lifts are used separately; endpoint crossings are omitted.

claims.parameter_scope: Conditional for each T,lambda and specified arc family; no joint asymptotic supply of graphs is asserted.
claims.error_bound: One crossing unit lost per arc; no unproved phase continuity through gaps is used.

limitations: Fixed delta only; no shrinking delta(T) theorem.
The threshold includes an O((log T)^2) analytic loss and a conservative explicit density-height cutoff.
No unconditional supply of balanced moving graphs with positive Re D is proved; E is not a cover of every derivative sign failure.
All actual mixture zeros in the window lie in the charged holes for the proved parameter regime; small projection cannot justify discarding them.
The original-window comparison pays full multiplicity for every cluster touching its boundary.
No individual root trajectory, simplicity, zero-existence, radial minimum, all-height exclusion, RH or improved zeta density statement.
Prior-art search is bounded; author contribution labels are not historical-novelty certification.

exception_report.exception_definition: E is the union of one general-position disk of radius in (T^(-2),2T^(-2)) per distinct actual zeta zero with beta>=1/2+delta/2 and T-2<=-Im rho<=2T+2, with each center's analytic multiplicity retained. Relevant clusters have closures meeting Omega.
exception_report.multiplicity_handling: M and M_j sum analytic multiplicities. Each full relevant cluster transfers exactly M_j zeros. Merging disks retains all charge. Boundary clusters pay their entire M_j; original window boundary zeros are included in closed counts.
exception_report.branch_handling: Local logs of P differ by integer multiples of 2pi i. The single-valued power-series correction q_lambda yields compatible logs of P+exp(-lambda), with identical offsets. Full component loops have period 2pi i M_j; no global log P is assumed.
exception_report.slicing_guard: Uniform minimum-modulus control is proved on two-dimensional disks and then on the full retained collar. Projected-length bounds are direct union bounds. No fixed-line distribution is promoted to a moving-curve theorem; positive-A arc existence remains unestablished.
